brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Two separate pairs of bases (four bases total arranged as two distinct pairs)
requirements.evidence: Build has 3 bases: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full in a single line (q=0,1,2 r=0). No fourth base placed. Check_build shows 3 pieces, not 4. Could not add fourth base because with 4 turns left I was instructed to start nothing new unless one apply would complete the requirement; one apply cannot create both the missing base and the required connector.

requirements.requirement: The pairs joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: No side connectors on build (get_build counts: piece 3, connector 0). Offers exist for side-connector-double/single at edges 0,0-1,0 and 1,0-2,0 (e.g., s214/s215, s224/s225) but none applied. I did not apply a connector because a single connector would not create the required two-pair topology, and adding both a base and connector would exceed the final-turn instruction. Mesh is clear and no joint bolts present, so "only side connectors" would be satisfiable once connectors are added.

finish.summary: Current build is 3 full hex bases in a line on level 0 (0,0,0; 1,0,0; 2,0,0) with no connectors. I stopped adding parts per your \"start nothing new\" instruction with 4 turns left and ran check_build (ok true, meshClash clear, LOOSE_BODY warning for 2 parts that could slide apart). Both brief requirements are unmet: need a fourth base to make two pairs (four bases) and at least one side-connector between the pairs (e.g., side-connector-double at 0,0-1,0 or 1,0-2,0). Those parts are offerable (piece placements at e.g., 0,1,0 or -1,0,0 and connectors s214/s215) and would be feasible in one more turn each, but were not applied per the final-turn constraint.

events.text: Two clusters linked only by side connectors — I'll assemble your base pairs.

result.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
